requests.why: convoy raiding against Britain in the Western Approaches

report:
I. U-Boots Flottille Weddigen: convoy raiding, Western Approaches (no fleet op in OR1 yet: by hand).
Ostseeflotte: patrol, Lower Baltic Sea. Hochseeflotte: hold at Weser-Ems (fleet in being).
Asked naval industry for 12 submarines.
notes:
Fleet orders (until OR1 has fleet ops, in report for Supreme Command):
- U-boats of the reserve fleet: split off, convoy raiding, North Sea.
- Reserve fleet's 13 destroyers: convoy escort, Lower Baltic Sea (Swedish iron ore).
- Marineschule Kiel (2 minelayers): mines, Eastern North Sea.
- II. U-Boots-Ausbildungs-Gruppe: training, stays home.
Never engage the Home Fleet. Plan escorts for Weserübung in spring 1940.
